items.title: Jins tay karne ke nizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the three sex-determination systems, block for block, with the Kitab ki ghalti box (PDF 103-105).

blocks.text: Drosophila, mammals aur zyada tar doosre vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale janwar) mein sex chromosomes ka jora aik danda numa (rod-shaped) X chromosome aur aik kunda numa (hook-shaped) Y chromosome par mushtamil hai. Maada XX aur nar XY hote hain. Drosophila mein autosomes ke 3 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora hai; insanon mein autosomes ke 22 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora.

In janwaron mein maada homogametic hai, yaani us ke sab eggs mein aik X chromosome hota hai. Nar heterogametic hai, yaani woh do qisam ke sperm banata hai: aadhe mein aik X aur aadhe mein aik Y. Agar X wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to zygote XX hoga; yeh embryo maada ke tolidi aaza (female sex organs) banata hai aur bachchi paida hoti hai. Agar Y wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to zygote XY hoga; yeh embryo nar ke tolidi aaza banata hai aur bachcha (larka) paida hota hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: Drosophila ka karyotype, autosome jore 1, 2 (do nuqte) aur 3 surmai khanon mein aur sex chromosomes gulabi khanon mein: XX (maada) aur XY (nar, kunde jaisa Y). Neeche: insani karyotype, autosome jore 1 se 22 chhote hote hue surmai khanon mein, aur sex chromosomes XX (maada) aur XY (nar) gulabi khanon mein. Key: surmai autosomes, gulabi sex chromosomes.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.12: Drosophila aur insan mein autosomes aur sex chromosomes (kitab ki Figure 18.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Drosophila karyotype, Human karyotype, Autosomes, Sex chromosomes, Female, Male, XX, XY.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Surmai khanon mein autosomes hain jo nar aur maada mein aik jaise hain; gulabi khanon mein sex chromosomes hain. Maada mein do X (XX) aur nar mein aik X aur aik chhota kunde jaisa Y (XY). Drosophila ke 3 autosome jore aur insan ke 22.

Jins tay karne ka yeh tareeqa kuch keeron (insects) mein milta hai. Misaal: tidde (grasshopper) ke 22 autosomes (11 jore) hain. Nar ke kul 23 chromosomes hain kyunke us ka sex chromosome 'jora' XO hai, yaani sirf aik X hai aur Y nahi. Nar do qisam ke sperm banata hai: aadhe mein X aur aadhe mein koi sex chromosome nahi. Jis gamete mein koi sex chromosome na ho use nullo gamete kehte hain.

Maada ke 24 chromosomes hain aur us ka sex chromosome jora XX hai. Sab eggs mein aik X hota hai. Agar X wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to XX maada bachcha banta hai; agar nullo sperm fertilize kare to XO nar bachcha banta hai.

Jins tay karne ka yeh tareeqa parindon (birds) mein aam hai. Mukhtalif parindon mein autosomes ki tadaad mukhtalif hoti hai, lekin sex chromosomes maada mein ZW aur nar mein ZZ hote hain. Yaani maada parinda do qisam ke eggs banata hai: aadhe Z wale aur aadhe W wale, jab ke nar ke sab sperm mein Z hota hai. Jab Z wala egg sperm se fertilize ho to bachcha nar (ZZ) hota hai; jab W wala egg fertilize ho to bachcha maada (ZW) hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai 'When a Y carrying egg is fertilized ... offspring is female'. Parindon mein Y chromosome hota hi nahi; ZW–ZZ nizam mein maada (ZW) dene wale egg mein W chromosome hota hai, is liye sahi 'W carrying egg' hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. Insan (XX-XY nizam): maada 44 + XX, nar 44 + XY; maada gametes X, X aur nar gametes X, Y se XX aur XY. Tidda (XX-XO nizam): maada 22 + XX, nar 22 + X-; nar gametes X aur - (koi sex chromosome nahi) se XX aur X-. Murghi (ZW-ZZ nizam): maada 76 + ZW, nar 76 + ZZ; maada gametes Z, W aur nar gametes Z, Z se ZZ aur ZW. Maada bachche hare, nar gulabi.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.13: Janwaron mein jins ka tay hona (sex determination) (kitab ki Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har hisse mein 2 x 2 grid: baen Female gametes, oopar Male gametes.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeno hisson mein 2 × 2 grid hai: baen taraf female gametes, oopar male gametes. Insan aur tidde mein nar do qisam ke sperm banata hai (X aur Y, ya X aur kuch nahi), is liye baap jins tay karta hai. Murghi mein maada do qisam ke eggs (Z aur W) banati hai, is liye maa jins tay karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Parindon mein bachche ki jins kaun sa walid tay karta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Maa. Woh ZW hai aur Z aur W do qisam ke eggs banati hai, jab ke baap (ZZ) sirf Z wale sperm banata hai.

items: XX-XY (insan, Drosophila): nar heterogametic; sperm jins tay karta hai.
XX-XO (tidda): nar XO, 23 chromosomes; nullo sperm se nar.
ZW-ZZ (parinde): maada heterogametic; egg jins tay karta hai.
